rows.ruling: Initial index0 bypasses reuse-only declaration/map sufficiency; canonical empty prefix uses zero actions. Positive index requires complete immutable base identity. Base+k1 atomically records EMPTY_PREFIX; no-base first learn has no plan/switch.

New revision references are closed variables,secrets,authoringIdentityVersion=1,authoredDeclarations. UTF-8/C byte ordering and unique reference IDs; plain valueHash and direct secretId identity. Java computes complete referenced union and current derived cache; never mutate old revisions.

rows.topic: Exact ACK contextHash and immutable program pair
rows.ruling: Issue metadata once; reconstruct full context with version inputs, hash exact full object. Both optional program fields must be present iff relearn plan exists and equal immutable values, including EMPTY_PREFIX/suffix. ACK names exact delivery/version/birth revision/hash and full current owning identity; original issued lease must remain live.

Header materialization_revision is frozen version-birth metadata. Later graph increments do not alter header or old proofs. Each PreparationFact.materializationRevision is the actual preparation snapshot metadata, may exceed birth revision; Java must compare captured context at prepare, not substitute current head or birth. SQL historical join uses contextRevision/contextId/ownerFence/input hash, deliberately not birth equality.

rows.topic: Canonical input bytes and count bounds
rows.ruling: Canonical UTF-8 <=32768 per full private input document; <=1048576 full authored-input payload and full issued context; <=200 entries; versions1..201. Control escaping/Unicode count by canonical bytes. Checked integer arithmetic refuses overflow; never truncate or mutate.

Session lock first for append, prepare, action admission/consume. Append refuses live preparation/inflight action/pending delivery. Current-version+ACK predicate gates prepare/admit/dispatch; completed old preparations retain historical validity.

Existing historical rows receive column0 from former unique semantic coordinate; do not rewrite document bytes. New ledgers require document attemptOrdinal0..1 equal column and obligation association. Sole attempt1 requires exact consumed attempt0 no-invocation receipt and drift switch; both admissions charge action budget.

studio_015_relearned_from returns SQL null until committed switch; after BOUNDARY/EMPTY_PREFIX returns initial step, DRIFT returns effective j plus driftSwitchStepId=j. PublicationReceipt requires explicit null/object. Later SOURCE_PLAN failure does not erase entered boundary and does not imply successful learning/publication.

rows.topic: Exact extended validation basis and evidence commitment
rows.ruling: SQL persists complete facts; Java reconstructs private full input snapshots, canonical hashes and exact frozen closed basis. Required materializationEvidence and nullable incrementalEvidence are part of existing basisHash; unchanged publicationEvidenceHash preimage. Pure validator checks exact historical memberships and sole excluded attempt. SQL/hash integrity never substitutes owning-worker authentication or real native-effect proof.

V19 seven retained progress keys/prune unchanged. Current/normalized materialized input values, source manifest, proposals/plans/caches remain F01 residual. New history does not erase existing values or prove compliance approval; external OBS010 security/retention obligations remain open.

componentAdapters.RelearnPlan: schemaVersion=3; session/test/csi from relearn_plan JOIN publication_base; baseRevisionId=base_revision_id; initialFirstLearnStepId=initial_step_id; initialFirstLearnIndex=initial_step_index; prefixProgramHash=prefix_program_hash
componentAdapters.Switch: schemaVersion=3; session/base/initial step from relearn plan; effectiveFirstLearnStepId=effective_step_id; effectiveFirstLearnIndex=effective_step_index; nextSemanticOrdinal=next_ordinal; completedPrefixCount=completed_prefix_count; reason; driftReceiptHash=nullable drift_receipt_hash; retainedPrefixAdmissionIds=completed_admissions; retainedPrefixAdmissionsHash=generated completed_admissions_hash
componentAdapters.MaterializationVersion: schemaVersion=3; session/worker/owner/scope/context/source/config columns; inputCount=input_count; previousInputsHash=previous_inputs_hash; birthMaterializationRevision=immutable materialization_revision
componentAdapters.MaterializationEntry: Private database shape: sessionId=session_id; inputOrdinal=input_ordinal; inputId=input_id; introducedContextRevision=introduced_revision; document=full private immutable input document. Never substitute this full shape for InputEvidenceEntry.
componentAdapters.PrefixRequestIdentity: Exact prefix_requests.document; request_digest hashes exact object. Canonical array order: draft step order, semantic ordinal, observation generation at issued request, tie requestDigest lexicographic. Resolve generation from acknowledged issued observation/evidence identity, never current observation or created_at.
componentAdapters.DriftReceipt: Exact no_invocation_receipts.document; hash excludes receiptHash alone; authentication is owning-worker transport, not hash
componentAdapters.ExcludedAttemptFact: Exact original action/preparation/obligation association, sole admitted no-invocation attempt0; not copied effective attempt1; admitted failure stays FAILED/TARGET_CHANGED with dispatchCount1
componentAdapters.FinalValidationBasis: Effective arrays retain every actual successful semantic action exactly once, exact original historical preparation; unused input history remains safe evidence metadata. materializationEvidence={versions ordered contextRevision,entries=InputEvidenceEntry ordered inputOrdinal}; incrementalEvidence=null without plan else exact plan/program/switch/ordered requests/nullable receipt/firstSuffixAcceptance/excludedAttempts. Unused full private entries are retained in database only.
componentAdapters.InputEvidenceEntry: Pure/public validation basis shape: inputOrdinal=input_ordinal; inputId=input_id; introducedContextRevision=introduced_revision; inputHash=studio_publication_hash(full private document); metadata=exact private document minus value. Entries ordered inputOrdinal; schema deliberately differs from private MaterializationEntry. Backend verifies full per-version canonical reconstruction before freezing the safe basis; runner receives no private nonsecret values.
